Question: I was doing a job at a gas station here in Calgary until I saw your fatwa regarding working at a place where lottery machine and cigarettes are there; so i stopped working there. The owner of the station requested me to come and work as soon as i change my mind. Now we, here in calgary, are in a great great need of a mosque and alhamdulillah, have got a plot too. But we still need to collect 50000-100000 until May 15. So now since we are in great need and are compelled, so can I again work in this staion only and only for getting money to put for this holy place? Will my money be halal? Answer ID: 22500 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 908/657/L=1431) In the question mentioned above, you are allowed to work in that station till the construction of the mosque completes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
